chunks: And share him in my task,
ai.seo_question: Who did Prophet Musa ask to share his prophetic mission with him?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Musa (AS) requests that his brother Harun (AS) share in his burden of prophethood, a request granted by Allah to ensure mutual support and clarity in conveying the message. Shia scholars highlight this as a model of seeking capable assistance in leadership and da'wah, emphasizing the virtue of familial cooperation in divine missions. The term 'amri' (my matter/affair) underscores the delegation of authority and shared responsibility in executing God's command.
